column1: # Star Citizen: game terms voices get wrong. written<TAB>spoken, optionally
# <TAB>languages (comma-separated codes) when the spoken form only fits some.
# Digits in the spoken form are fine: they are read in the spoken language
# afterwards ("F 7 C" becomes "F sieben C" in German).
# German voices would read "U E C" as German letters; players say them in
# English. The first matching line wins, so the German one comes first.
